notes.title: Windows 7 and Windows 8.x Support
notes.content:
Hello,

   As you know [url=https://help.steampowered.com/en/faqs/view/4784-4F2B-1321-800A]Steam client stops supporting Windows 7 and Windows 8.x operating systems from January 1, 2024[/url]
   Although the working condition of our games does not depend on Google Chrome and most likely will work on Windows 7, but over time this work will not be guaranteed in the future, which means that the minimum requirements for games will be increased to Windows 10 from next year.

Thanks!

notes.title: GraphXGames sales have been restored on Steam.
notes.content:
Good news!!!
The Steam Team has been hard working in recent months to restore payments to Ukraine. For which we are grateful to them, which allows us to continue cooperation with the Steam platform.
Thanks to all.

notes.title: GraphXGames sales are suspended in Steam.
notes.content:
GraphXGames is ending sales on Steam because Steam can no longer send payments to Ukraine. 
Perhaps we will switch to direct sales later from our site.
Thanks to everyone who was with us!
